reason: Specification v002 lets users change a task's status (To do / In progress / Done) from a labelled, keyboard-operable control on each task in the list, with the list, status filter and results count updating immediately. No answers or feedback arrived since v001, so scope and criteria are unchanged apart from small accuracy fixes. Q1 (should changed statuses persist across reloads like stars?) is still open and decides whether AC6 and AC7 and the storage work are in scope; the proposed default is to persist. Q2 is non-material and has an explicit assumption.
